name: Brannoc Sparkwell
title: Smith
quirk: Huge, gentle, terrified of moths. Names every hammer.
greeting: Big Bran's forge! Mind the sparks. And the moths. Mostly the moths.
barks: This is Hammer Gerald. Say hello to Gerald.
Upgrading never breaks a thing. Not on my anvil.
Is that a moth? Tell me that's not a moth.
Bring me Soot Dust. I'll bring the shine.
Hot iron, warm heart. That's the rule.
Hammer Gerald's cousin is Hammer Gertrude. She's for fancy work.
Every sword remembers the hand that made it. Mine remember hugs.
bark_after_act: You rang the old bell back to life! Gerald is so proud.

name: Nettle Pim
title: Alchemist
quirk: Tiny. Sneezes glitter when potions fizz.
greeting: Oh! A customer! Hold on, I need to climb onto my stool.
barks: Red potion: feel better. Blue potion: don't drink the blue one.
Ah— ah— ACHOO! Sorry. Glitter. It happens.
Bone Meal makes lovely potions. Don't ask how.
Tall people always knock over my shelves.
Fizzing means it's working! Or broken. Usually working.
Drink a potion when your light gets low. Easy!
bark_after_act: The bog lights came back! My potions fizz twice as happy now.

name: Madame Glimmerwick
title: Jeweler
quirk: Wears 40 rings. Always looking for the one she's wearing.
greeting: Welcome, darling! Have you seen my blue ring? …Oh. Found it.
barks: Forty rings, and not one is the right one.
A gem in a socket is a little star in your pocket.
Candle Ruby for courage. Frost Sapphire for calm.
I polish my rings so often they polish me back.
Never trust a Magpie Imp near a jewellery box.
Darling, that amulet is SO you.
bark_after_act: The Bellringer's rekindled! I shall wear my celebration ring. Where is it…

name: Grandpa Knurl
title: Runecarver
quirk: Carves runes on everything, including his spoons.
greeting: Hm? Oh, hello. Mind the table. I carved a rune on it.
barks: This spoon has a rune for 'soup'. Very useful.
Runes are just words that remember to work.
Carve slow. The wood tells you where.
I once carved 'brave' on my boots. Didn't help.
When you reach Rimehall, find Master Quillon. He carves ice!
My chair says 'sit'. So I do.
bark_after_act: I carved 'thank you' on my door for you. Go and see.

name: Pocket Polly
title: Trader
quirk: Coat with a hundred pockets. Never the right one.
greeting: Buying? Selling? Let me check my pockets. All of them.
barks: Pocket forty-two… no, that's a frog. Sorry, frog.
I've got a pocket for everything. Finding it is extra.
I buy anything shiny. Except Magpie Imps. They buy back.
Fair prices, honest pockets!
One of my pockets hums at night. I don't check that one.
Something you don't need? I'll give you coins for it.
bark_after_act: You're a hero now! I've made you your own pocket.

name: Humphrey
title: Stash Keeper
quirk: A very old tortoise. Counts everything twice.
greeting: Your… things… are… safe. One. One. Two. Two.
barks: Nothing… lost… in… a hundred… years.
Slow… and… safe.
Your stash… follows you… to every… town. Clever… that.
I counted… your socks. Twice. All there.
Don't… rush. I never… do.
Shell… is also… a stash.
bark_after_act: The… bell… rang. I… heard it. Twice.

name: Hattie Hayloft
title: Stablemaster
quirk: Rents giant bog-newts. Speaks for them.
greeting: Hello! Puddle says hello too. Don't you, Puddle? She does.
barks: Puddle says you look like a good rider.
A newt on the path is faster than two boots in the mud.
If something bonks you, you'll hop off. Newts are shy.
Squelch says he wants a snack. Squelch always wants a snack.
Riding's quicker in the zones and in town, dear.
Pat them on the nose. Gently. They like that.
bark_after_act: Puddle says you're the bravest person she's ever carried.

name: Wren Whistleby
title: Pet Keeper
quirk: Nine years old. Extremely serious about pets.
greeting: State your pet's name and favourite snack, please.
barks: Pets pick up loot for you. Very professional.
Pets get stronger when you go adventuring together.
Some pets dig up treasure. I'm not jealous. I'm a bit jealous.
Every pet deserves a good name. Not 'Pet'.
I've got a list of all the pets in Lumenholm. It's long.
Pets don't fight. They help. That's different.
bark_after_act: My pets and I made you a medal. It's a leaf. It's a medal leaf.

name: Mother Mabble
title: Innkeeper
quirk: Runs The Soggy Candle. Believes soup fixes everything.
greeting: Sit down, pet. Soup's hot. Everything's better after soup.
barks: Rest here and the Homeward Wick will bring you back.
Resting makes your light glow brighter. That's just true.
Soup of the day: soup.
The roof leaks, but only on people who complain.
You look tired. Tired is allowed.
A warm bed, a warm bowl, a warm light. That's home.
bark_after_act: Soup's on the house tonight. Well. Soup's always on the house.

name: Warden Hollis Reed
title: Warden
quirk: Last Lamplighter of Wickmire. Helmet two sizes too big.
greeting: Wickbearer! Thank the light. I mean it. I really need help.
barks: The helmet was my father's. I'll grow into it.
Stay in your light and you'll be alright.
The Rattlebones aren't bad. They're just lost.
Every lamp we tie down is one more we keep.
When you're tired, come back. The bog will wait.
I heard a bell under the water last night.
One step at a time. That's how you cross a bog.
bark_after_act: Tolly's home. The lamps are down. You did that. We did that.

name: Grandmother Purl
title: Storyteller
quirk: Knits while she talks. The scarf is never finished.
greeting: Come sit, little light. Pass me that yarn and I'll tell you a tale.
barks: Knit one, purl one, tell one story.
This scarf is for everyone in the village. It's a long scarf.
Once, the sky had a lantern, and nobody thought to thank it.
The Grey Guest knocked on my door once. I gave him tea.
My granddaughter sews dolls that talk back. Takes after me.
Every story is a light you can carry in your head.
Lost your way? Follow the lamps. They float toward home.
bark_after_act: Tolly used to ring for my tea. He'll ring again now, you'll see.

name: Flicker
title: Waypoint Keeper
quirk: A small wisp. Flickers when it fibs.
greeting: Hi! I'm Flicker! I'm not scared at all! *flicker*
barks: Touch a waypoint once and you can come back any time!
Travelling to town is free. The rest costs a little gold.
I've been to every waypoint. *flicker* Okay, two.
Wisps like me show the way. Not like the bad wisps. We're nice.
Tap the map to go places!
I'm the brightest wisp in Wickmire! *flicker flicker*
bark_after_act: You did it! I wasn't worried. *flicker* I was a bit worried.

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
quirk: Not a person. A board. Repeatable bounties that bank and never expire.
greeting: The Lamplight Hollow Bounty Board. Pinned notes flap in the bog breeze.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.
bark_after_act: Someone pinned a thank-you note to the board. It's addressed to you.

name: Tamsin Knotwood
title: Smith
quirk: Apologises to trees before using wood.
greeting: Sorry, tree. Oh! Hello. Sorry. I talk to trees.
barks: Sorry, log. This won't hurt a bit.
Wood remembers where it grew. Be kind to it.
Axe handles, bow staves, and one very nice spoon.
Upgrading here is just like Big Bran's. Only woodier.
The birches told me a secret about you. I didn't listen.
Every nick in a blade is a story.
bark_after_act: The shadows are home! The trees are finally quiet. Well. Quieter.

name: Professor Fennimore Puffcap
title: Alchemist
quirk: Part mushroom. Puffs sparkly spores when surprised.
greeting: Ah, a student! Welcome to the finest laboratory in any tree. *puff*
barks: Alchemy: turning 'oops' into 'ooh!'
Potions, elixirs, transmutes. All the -ions and -irs.
Don't startle me. *puff* See? Sparkles everywhere.
Two small things can become one useful thing. That's the trick.
Mushrooms are excellent listeners. Terrible at maths.
Let me show you the station. Just one little brew to start.
Elixirs last a while. Enjoy the glow.
bark_after_act: Mother Bark sent me a thank-you note. Written on bark. Naturally. *puff*

name: Cress Dewdrop
title: Jeweler
quirk: Collects dewdrops as gems. They keep evaporating.
greeting: Hello! Careful where you step. That's a jewel. Was a jewel.
barks: My best gem evaporated this morning. Again.
Moss Emeralds don't evaporate. That's why I like them.
Put a gem in a socket and it helps you forever.
Dew is just tiny water that dreams of being a gem.
Pretty things are best shared.
I found a gem in an owl's nest. The owl found me.
bark_after_act: The morning dew is back! My shop is full again!

name: Hob Mossbeard
title: Runecarver
quirk: His beard grows moss. Carves runes on acorns.
greeting: Mm. Welcome. Don't mind the beard. It's thriving.
barks: A rune on an acorn grows into a rune on a tree.
Something is living in my beard. We have an agreement.
Slow carving, quick magic.
My brother Knurl carves spoons. Spoons. Honestly.
The forest has its own runes. You just have to read bark.
Beard's getting long. It's got a mushroom now.
bark_after_act: My beard grew a flower when the shadows came home. Look!

name: Mister Quibble
title: Trader
quirk: An owl-man who haggles in riddles.
greeting: Whooo's buying? What has pockets but no coat? My shop!
barks: What's cheaper than cheap? A good deal!
I sell by day, I sell by night. Well. Mostly night.
Riddle me this: what's worth more once you use it?
Everything here is lightly loved.
Hoo-hoo! Sharp eyes, fair prices.
The answer to every riddle is 'buy one'. Just kidding.
bark_after_act: Whooo rekindled Mother Bark? You! That's not even a riddle.

name: Nutsy
title: Stash Keeper
quirk: A squirrel who buries your stash. Finds it. Mostly.
greeting: Stash? STASH! Yes! I buried it! It's… somewhere! Good spot!
barks: I remember EVERY hiding place! …Most of them!
Your stash is the same in every town. Magic! Or tunnels.
I found an acorn from last year! Snack!
Buried treasure is the best treasure!
Don't worry. I've never lost anything. Recently.
Chitter chitter! That means 'safe' in squirrel.
bark_after_act: I buried a present for you! Somewhere! It's a surprise for both of us!

name: Ferris Longstride
title: Stablemaster
quirk: Rents moss-deer. Whistles instead of saying yes.
greeting: *whistles* That means welcome. Want a deer?
barks: *whistles* That means yes.
Moss-deer never trip on roots. Never.
Get bumped and you'll hop down. Deer don't like fights.
This one's Fern. That one's also Fern. They like it.
Faster through the woods, faster through the town.
*long whistle* That means 'have a good ride'.
bark_after_act: *happy whistle* That means 'thank you', by the way.

name: Juniper Fitch
title: Pet Keeper
quirk: Raises owlets. Answers in hoots when distracted.
greeting: Hello! Shh. Owlet nap time. Hoo. Sorry. Hello.
barks: Owlets sleep all day. Best job ever.
Hoo? Oh, sorry. What did you ask?
A pet finds shiny things you'd walk right past.
Level up your pet by adventuring together.
Wren from Lamplight Hollow writes me pet letters!
This owlet is called Doughnut. Don't ask why. She knows why.
bark_after_act: The owlets can see their shadows again. They keep jumping at them.

name: Bramble Hartwell
title: Innkeeper
quirk: Runs The Hollow Knot. Every bed is a hammock.
greeting: Welcome to The Hollow Knot! Beds are hammocks. Don't fall out.
barks: All our beds rock. Literally.
Bind your Homeward Wick here and you'll always get home.
Nap in a hammock and the forest sings you to sleep.
A rest is not a stop. It's a refill.
Tea? It's acorn tea. It's a bit crunchy.
Nobody's fallen out of a hammock this week. Big week.
bark_after_act: Whole forest's sleeping better since you came. Me too.

name: Ranger Sorrel Vane
title: Ranger
quirk: Jumps at every whisper. Brave anyway.
greeting: AH! Oh. It's you. Sorry. The trees keep whispering.
barks: Did you hear that? That was a whisper. Probably about me.
Brave doesn't mean not scared. I'm very brave.
The Owlcrows see everything. Even when you sneak.
The shadows are missing. Look at your feet in the woods.
Twiglings pretend to be sticks. Poke every stick.
When it gets too much, take a break. I do. Often.
bark_after_act: The trees whispered 'thank you' today. I only jumped a little.

name: Old Hoot
title: Storyteller
quirk: Very, very old owl. Answers questions with questions.
greeting: Who comes to Old Hoot? And why? And who's asking?
barks: What is a shadow, if not light's best friend?
Did you know my apprentice pulls stars from the sky? Did I teach her that?
Why do trees whisper? What would you say, if you were a tree?
Who blew out the Lantern? Why would anyone?
Is the dark empty, or just waiting?
What's heavier: a lantern, or carrying it alone?
bark_after_act: Who rekindled the oldest tree? And who will tell the story? Hm?

name: Lumen the Glowworm
title: Waypoint Keeper
quirk: A big glowworm. Speaks in rhymes.
greeting: Hello, hello, a traveller's here! Pick a place, and I'll steer.
barks: Touch a stone, it's yours to keep. Travel there before you sleep!
To town is free, the rest a coin. Where would you like to join?
I glow, I glow, from tail to head. The map is where you go instead.
Waypoints shine like little stars. Near or far, the path is ours.
Lost in the wood? Don't make a fuss. Come back here and ride with us.
A rhyme a day keeps the Hush away!
bark_after_act: The wood is bright, the shadows home. Now pick a place wherever you roam!

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
quirk: Not a person. A board. Repeatable bounties that bank and never expire.
greeting: The Owlstead Bounty Board. Notes are pinned with acorns.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.
bark_after_act: Someone pinned a thank-you note to the board. It's addressed to you.

name: Dorra Anvilsong
title: Smith
quirk: Sings to the anvil. Bellstriker's aunt. Very loud.
greeting: WELCOME TO THE FORGE! SORRY! IT'S A LOUD FORGE!
barks: CLANG! That's the chorus.
My nephew's got a bell for a hammer. Runs in the family!
SING while you hammer and the metal sits up straight!
Upgrades never fail here. Loud AND reliable.
Mines are quiet now. Too quiet. Needs more CLANG.
If you see my nephew, tell him to wear a scarf.
bark_after_act: THE MOUNTAIN'S SINGING AGAIN! I'M CRYING! IT'S LOUD CRYING!

name: Fizzwick Drabb
title: Alchemist
quirk: Blows things up slightly. Eyebrows always regrowing.
greeting: Welcome! Don't mind the smoke. Or the eyebrows. They're coming back.
barks: Pop! That was supposed to happen. Mostly.
Salt makes everything better. Even potions. Especially potions.
Professor Puffcap taught me. He still sends me spore letters.
Safety goggles! I should wear those.
My eyebrows grow back faster every time. Science!
This one's a transmute. Tiny stuff into better stuff.
bark_after_act: The Echo sang so loud my potion popped. Worth it.

name: Opaline Facet
title: Jeweler
quirk: Polishes everything, including you.
greeting: Oh, you're a bit dusty. Hold still. *polish polish* There.
barks: Every gem was once a bit of mountain dreaming.
Sockets, gems, rings, amulets. I do all of it. Shinily.
Let me show you the station. One gem, one socket, one smile.
Crystal Spiders are made of gems. Don't polish them.
Dust is just shine that's shy.
*polish* Sorry. Habit. Your elbow was dull.
bark_after_act: The whole mountain is sparkling. I don't even need to polish. I will anyway.

name: Chisel
title: Runecarver
quirk: A small stone-golem child. Speaks one word at a time.
greeting: Hello. Rune. Please.
barks: Carve. Tap. Glow.
Stone. Friend.
Rune. Strong.
Me. Small. Rock. Big.
Quillon. Ice. Teacher. Far.
You. Nice.
bark_after_act: Mountain. Song. Happy. Me. Happy.

name: Gus Two-Carts
title: Trader
quirk: One cart sells. The other 'buys back'.
greeting: Left cart buys, right cart sells. Or the other way. Let's find out!
barks: Two carts, twice the bargains!
Found it in the mines! It's basically new. Basically.
If one cart rolls away, the prices roll with it.
Sell me what you don't need. I'll find it a good home.
Best prices under the mountain! Only prices under the mountain!
Ever seen a cart with teeth? Don't buy that one.
bark_after_act: I'm naming a third cart after you. I just need a third cart.

name: Pickett
title: Stash Keeper
quirk: Keeps stashes in mine carts. One rolls away daily. It comes back.
greeting: Stash cart's ready! Wait. Where's cart six? Oh, there it goes.
barks: Don't worry. The carts always come back. The track's a circle.
Your stash is safe in every town. Even on wheels.
Cart six is the adventurous one.
I oil the wheels every morning. Squeak-free stashing!
Everything you put in, stays in. Rails' honour.
Here comes cart six! Told you.
bark_after_act: Cart six came back with a crystal in it. I think it's for you.

name: Mags Rattlebridle
title: Stablemaster
quirk: Rents rock-ponies. Knows the shortest way to everything.
greeting: Need to get somewhere? I know a shortcut. I always know a shortcut.
barks: Rock-ponies never get tired. They get sleepy. It's different.
Shortest way to the lift? Left, left, down, whee.
Get bonked and you're off the pony. Rules of the rocks.
This is Gravel. That's Pebble. That's Other Gravel.
Riding's faster. Walking's scenic. Your choice.
Shortcut to happiness? Pat a pony.
bark_after_act: The shortest way to a hero's heart is a pony ride. Free one, for you.

name: Tuppence
title: Pet Keeper
quirk: Tiny and fearless. Best friends with a glow-mole.
greeting: This is Dimple. She's a glow-mole. She likes you. I can tell.
barks: Dimple digs up treasure! Some pets do that!
I'm not scared of anything. Except baths.
Pets help find materials. Dimple found a whole sandwich.
Echo bats make great pets. They copy your giggles.
Pets get better the more you explore together.
Dimple says hi. That was the hi. The wiggle.
bark_after_act: Dimple did a happy dig. It's a tunnel. It spells your name. Nearly.

name: Barnaby Ballast
title: Innkeeper
quirk: Runs The Deep Breath. Laughs so loud the lift shakes.
greeting: Welcome to The Deep Breath! HA HA! Sorry. Lift's fine. Probably.
barks: We pump fresh air all the way down! Breathe deep!
Bind your Homeward Wick here. HA! Home is where the laugh is!
Rest up. A tired miner digs holes in the wrong places.
My laugh broke a crystal once. Now it's two crystals. Bonus!
Stew's got salt. Everything's got salt. It's a salt mine.
Stay as long as you like, friend.
bark_after_act: HA HA HA! Sorry, happy laugh. The lift will stop shaking soon.

name: Foreman Hilda Pickwell
title: Foreman
quirk: Has a list of why they dig. The list is blank.
greeting: Wickbearer. Good. I have a list of jobs. And a list of reasons. One's blank.
barks: Why do we dig? It's on my list. The list is blank.
Diglings were my crew. They're not bad. They forgot.
Lamp ghosts wander the tunnels looking for their miners.
Keep your light up in the shafts. It's dark down there.
When your pack's full, come up. The mine's not going anywhere.
There used to be a song. I can almost hear it.
bark_after_act: 'Dig deep, dig bright.' That's it. That's why. I'm writing it down.

name: Echo Annie
title: Storyteller
quirk: Repeats the last word of every sentence. Sentence.
greeting: Sit down, dearie, and I'll tell you a story. Story.
barks: The mountain used to sing to us. Us.
Every tunnel holds a memory. Memory.
When the lamps went out, the song went too. Too.
The Great Echo copies everything. Everything.
I've always done this. Nobody knows why. Why.
A quiet mountain is a lonely mountain. Mountain.
bark_after_act: The song's back, dearie. The song. Song. Oh, I'm so happy. Happy.

name: Lou Lever
title: Waypoint Keeper
quirk: Runs the great lift. Announces every floor, even when there aren't any.
greeting: Going up! Going down! Going sideways, if you like the map!
barks: Floor one: waypoints. Floor two: also waypoints.
Mind the gap. There's no gap. Mind it anyway.
Town trips are free. Other stops cost a coin.
Ding! That's my lift bell. Not your nephew, Dorra.
Next stop: wherever you tap.
Doors closing! There are no doors.
bark_after_act: Going up! All the way up! Well done, Wickbearer!

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
quirk: Not a person. A board. Repeatable bounties that bank and never expire.
greeting: The Clinkerton Bounty Board. Chalk on a slate. Someone drew a pickaxe with a face.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.
bark_after_act: Someone pinned a thank-you note to the board. It's addressed to you.

name: Corporal Tinwhistle
title: Smith
quirk: A retired tin soldier. Salutes everything, including the anvil.
greeting: Attention! *salute* A visitor! *salute* To the anvil! *salute*
barks: *salute* That was for the hammer.
Polished boots, polished blade, polished upgrade!
I was a soldier once. Now I'm a smith. Still saluting.
Upgrades succeed on first try. That is an order!
My old regiment froze in the hall. I'll wait for them.
Left, right, left, CLANG.
bark_after_act: My regiment thawed! They saluted me! I saluted back! We're still going!

name: Cook Dumplina
title: Alchemist
quirk: The castle cook. All her potions are soups.
greeting: Hungry? Hurt? Same thing, pet. Have a soup.
barks: Healing soup. Strength soup. Soup soup.
Every potion's a soup if you believe.
Mother Mabble in Wickmire? My cousin! Soup runs in families.
Don't drink it too hot. Or do. It's a warming soup.
The frozen guests haven't eaten in a year. I've kept the pot on.
Carrots help you see in the dark. Very useful now.
bark_after_act: Everyone's thawed and everyone's HUNGRY. Pass the big ladle!

name: Lady Facetta Frostglass
title: Jeweler
quirk: Keeper of the crown jewels. Extremely proper. Secretly giggly.
greeting: Good evening. One does jewels here. Properly. *tiny giggle*
barks: A lady never giggles. *giggle* Oh dear.
The crown jewels are frozen. I polish them anyway.
Frost Sapphire. Terribly elegant. Terribly cold.
Please do not lick the ice. One has seen it happen.
A ring for the brave, a gem for the kind.
One's cousin Glimmerwick has too many rings. One has just enough.
bark_after_act: The King said my name! He remembered my name! *giggle giggle*

name: Master Quillon Rimecarve
title: Runecarver
quirk: Carves runes in ice. Hates warmth. Lives in a kitchen.
greeting: Close the door. Warmth is getting in. Ugh. Kitchens.
barks: Ice holds a rune perfectly. Until it melts. Hence: no kettles.
Enchant, reroll, refine. Precision is kindness.
Let me show you the station. One rune. Clean lines.
Chisel sends me letters. One word each. I treasure them.
Knurl carves spoons. I carve spoons too. In ice. Better spoons.
Someone put the kettle on again. *sigh*
bark_after_act: The castle is warm again. I hate it. I'm very happy. Both.

name: Crumbsworth
title: Trader
quirk: A mouse merchant who runs his shop from a teacup.
greeting: Welcome to Crumbsworth's Teacup Emporium! Mind the handle.
barks: Small shop. Big deals.
I accept gold, crumbs, and particularly good cheese.
Everything here fits in a teacup. Except that sword. Somehow.
The mirror butlers kept trying to serve my shop.
Sell anything! I'll squeeze it in. Squeak.
Crumbsworth's rule: never trade with a cat.
bark_after_act: In honour of the King, cheese is half price! Wait, I sell cheese?

name: Mister Ledger
title: Stash Keeper
quirk: The only butler who didn't freeze. Writes everything down.
greeting: Good evening. Your belongings are catalogued. Page nine thousand.
barks: Item received. Item noted. Item cherished.
I did not freeze because I was busy writing. Recommend it.
Your stash is shared in every town. I have the records.
One sock, blue, slightly heroic. Noted.
The mirror butlers were my colleagues. They serve tea wrongly now.
Everything in order. As always.
bark_after_act: Entry: the King remembers. Underlined twice.

name: Noll Frostmane
title: Stablemaster
quirk: Rents snow-hares and sleds. Tells you to wrap up warm.
greeting: Wrap up warm! Then pick a hare. Then wrap up warmer.
barks: Snow-hares hop over drifts. Boots don't.
Scarf? Scarf. Put on a scarf.
Take a bump and you'll tumble off. Hares are gentle souls.
This one's Flurry. That's Sleet. That's Mister Fluffington.
Faster in the gardens, faster in the halls.
Did you wrap up warm? Just checking.
bark_after_act: It's warm now! …Wrap up anyway. Habit.

name: Princess Pip
title: Pet Keeper
quirk: The king's daughter, 8. Bossy, kind, misses her dad.
greeting: I'm Princess Pip and I'm in charge of the royal pets. Bow. Or wave. Waving's fine.
barks: The royal corgi-hare is called Sir Wobble. Salute him.
Pets need love, snacks, and adventures. In that order.
Kit taught me to climb roofs. Don't tell Nan Kettleby.
My dad forgot my name. I'll help him remember.
A pet can find treasure you'd never see.
I'm not sad. I'm just busy being brave.
bark_after_act: He remembered me first. Before anyone. Before his own crown.

name: Nan Kettleby
title: Innkeeper
quirk: Keeps the great kettle boiling. Tea solves most things.
greeting: Kettle's on, dearie. It's always on. Sit by the warm.
barks: Tea for the cold, tea for the sad, tea for the tired.
Bind your Homeward Wick here. The kettle will be on.
A cup and a sit-down. Nothing's so bad after that.
Rest is how heroes get heroic.
Master Quillon hates my kettle. I make him tea anyway.
That child Pip is climbing the roof again, isn't she.
bark_after_act: Kettle's never been so busy. Whole castle wants a cup. Bless you.

name: Chancellor Pellinore Snowdrop
title: Chancellor
quirk: Half his moustache is still frozen. Keeps lists of lists.
greeting: Ah. You're on my list. My list of people who might help. It's short.
barks: List of lists: item one, this list.
Half my moustache thawed. The other half is thinking about it.
His Majesty grows colder the less he remembers.
Letters of his name are scattered in the halls. Find them.
Mind the mirrors. Reflections here are running late.
Do take breaks. It's on my list. Near the top.
bark_after_act: Item one: the King is himself again. Item two: I'm crying. Item three: tissues.

name: Tumblewit the Jester
title: Storyteller
quirk: Tells sad stories funnily and funny stories sadly.
greeting: A tale, a tale! Shall it be sad? It'll be funny. Or the other way.
barks: Once there was a king with the warmest hall. …That's the sad part.
Why did the snowman cry? He was having a meltdown.
Jingle jingle. My bells are frozen. So they just go 'jin'.
The toast was never finished. That's the saddest joke I know.
Laughing keeps you warm. Try it! Ha. See?
Every king needs a fool. Every fool needs a friend.
bark_after_act: The toast got finished. I laughed so hard I cried. Or the other way.

name: Tick
title: Waypoint Keeper
quirk: A small clockwork girl. Ticks when she thinks.
greeting: Hello. Tick. Tick. Where would you like to go?
barks: Tick. Tick. Calculating route. Tick. Done.
Waypoints remember you once you've touched them.
Town is free. Other places: small fee. Tick.
I was built to keep time. Now I keep places.
Wind me up if I slow down. Please.
Tick tock. That's my happy noise.
bark_after_act: Tick. Tick. Tick-tick-tick! That's my VERY happy noise.

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
quirk: Not a person. A board. Repeatable bounties that bank and never expire.
greeting: The Kettlekeep Bounty Board. Notes written in very neat handwriting. Mister Ledger's, probably.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.
bark_after_act: Someone pinned a thank-you note to the board. It's addressed to you.

name: Mae Coalbright
title: Smith
quirk: Forged the Guild's lanterns for 70 years. Still 'just learning'.
greeting: Come in, come in. I'm still just learning, mind. Only seventy years.
barks: I made your lantern's great-great-grandmother.
Upgrades never fail. After seventy years, I should hope not.
Every lantern needs a good cap, a good glass and a good friend.
Big Bran was my apprentice! He's still scared of moths.
Out here, the only colour is the one we make.
A good hammer is a patient hammer.
bark_after_act: The Lantern's lit. I made its cap, you know. Seventy years ago. Still holds.

name: Mother Simmer
title: Cauldron Keeper
quirk: Tends the Cauldron. Talks to it. It burbles back.
greeting: Hello, dearie. The Cauldron says hello too. *burble*
barks: Put anything in. See what comes out. The Cauldron never breaks a thing.
*burble* She likes you. She only burbles twice for friends.
Secret recipes are just surprises with instructions.
Every discovery goes in your journal. Keep it handy.
Let me show you. One little mix to start.
Stir left for luck. Stir right for soup.
bark_after_act: The Cauldron burbled a whole song today. She's proud of you.

name: Twinkle
title: Jeweler
quirk: A fallen star the size of a teacup. Very sensitive about it.
greeting: I'm a star! A real one! I'm just… compact.
barks: Don't call me small. Call me concentrated.
I fell from the sky the night the Lantern went out.
Gems are just stars that decided to stay.
I can socket anything. With help. From a stool.
Stargazers keep trying to throw me. Please don't.
Big twinkle or small twinkle, still a twinkle.
bark_after_act: I can see the sky again! My family's up there! Hi, everyone!

name: Vesper Inkwell
title: Runecarver
quirk: Writes runes in light. They fade if you blink.
greeting: Don't blink. There. You blinked. Let me write it again.
barks: A rune of light lasts as long as someone reads it.
Ink, light, patience.
Quillon carves ice. I write light. We argue by letter.
Every rune is a small promise.
Read slowly. The words like it.
*writes* *you blink* *sigh* Again.
bark_after_act: I wrote your name in light over the Landing. Nobody's blinked all day.

name: Nib
title: Trader
quirk: A reformed Magpie Imp. 'I don't steal. I borrow permanently.'
greeting: Shinies! Lovely shinies! All borrowed! Permanently! Legally!
barks: I used to be a Magpie Imp. Now I'm a magpie businessman.
You caught my cousin in Wickmire. She says hi. Grumpily.
Fair prices! Mostly fair! Fairly fair!
Ooh, is that shiny? Can I— no. No. I'm reformed.
The Hoard? Never heard of it. What Hoard.
Sell me your shinies and I'll give them a good home.
bark_after_act: You relit the whole SKY? That's the shiniest thing anyone's ever done!

name: Keeper Stillwater
title: Stash Keeper
quirk: Perfectly calm. Has never hurried. Not even once.
greeting: Welcome. Take your time. There is always time.
barks: Nothing here is in a hurry. Least of all me.
Your stash is safe. Breathe in. Breathe out.
Hurrying makes you drop things. So I never hurry.
Everything you keep, I keep.
The Hush is quiet. So am I. We're different, though.
Rest is not wasted time.
bark_after_act: The Lantern's lit. I'm very happy. You can tell by my… calm.

name: Captain Loft
title: Stablemaster
quirk: Rents great moths. Wears goggles indoors.
greeting: Goggles on! Moths ready! Captain Loft, at your service!
barks: Great moths fly toward light. That's you. Handy!
Bump into trouble and you'll hop off. Moths hate fuss.
Goggles indoors? Can't be too careful.
This is Dusty. She's very soft and very fast.
Faster on the islands. Faster through the Landing.
Big Bran's scared of my moths. Tell him they're friendly!
bark_after_act: Moths everywhere tonight! Must be the brightest night in history!

name: Tansy Glow
title: Pet Keeper
quirk: Keeps fireflies in jars and lets them out every night.
greeting: Hello! These are my fireflies. They're only visiting.
barks: Every night I open the jars. Every morning they come back.
Pets are friends who choose to stay.
Mystery eggs hatch into all sorts. Carry one around!
A pet at full level is a proper best friend.
Juniper sends me owl feathers. I send her fireflies.
Light is better shared. Even firefly light.
bark_after_act: All my fireflies came back at once and spelled 'THANKS'. Mostly.

name: Aunt Lumi
title: Innkeeper
quirk: Runs The Last Lamp. Leaves a light in every window.
greeting: Come in from the grey, love. There's a light in every window for you.
barks: A lit window means someone's waiting for you.
Bind your Homeward Wick here. There'll always be a light on.
The Well is cold. The Last Lamp isn't.
Resting is part of carrying the light. Ada forgets that.
Sit. Warm up. The Well will still be there.
Nobody's too tired to be welcome.
bark_after_act: Every window in the world is lit tonight. I cried into the tea.

name: Ada Brightly
title: Master Wickwright
quirk: The last Guild master. Very old, very kind, very bad at rest.
greeting: A Wickbearer. At last. Sit, sit. I'll stand. I always stand.
barks: A light shared is not a light lost. That's the Guild's rule.
I knew the Grey Guest once. Before he was grey.
Ninety-nine chairs in our hall. Only one is ever sat in.
Down is up in the Well. Walk carefully.
I should rest more. Don't tell Aunt Lumi I said that.
Carry the light. Share it when you can. Rest when you need to.
bark_after_act: Pell. Oh, Pell. I should have climbed the stair with you. …Thank you, Wickwright.

name: The Moth Choir
title: Storyteller
quirk: A thousand moths. They sing. You'll have to lean in.
greeting: *tiny chorus* Hellooo, little light! Lean in, lean in!
barks: *sing* Once was a spark that wandered alone…
*sing* The Hush said nothing, and so it shone…
*hum* Where moths gather, secrets hide.
*sing* One keeper climbed, and nobody came…
*giggle* You're very bright. We like bright.
*sing* Carry the light, and then pass it on…
bark_after_act: *loudest tiny chorus ever* THE LANTERN! THE LANTERN! WE LOVE IT!

name: Nobody
title: Waypoint Keeper
quirk: A friendly Hushling: just a hat and a polite silence.
greeting: …  (Nobody tips its hat. The map glows.)
barks: …  (Nobody points at the map. Politely.)
…  (Nobody waves. You think it's a wave.)
…  (A tiny, happy silence.)
…  (Nobody straightens its hat. It is very proud of the hat.)
…  (Nobody seems to be saying: town trips are free.)
…  (Somewhere, very quietly, a hum.)
bark_after_act: …!  (For the first time, Nobody makes a sound. It's a small 'yay'.)

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
quirk: Not a person. A board. Repeatable bounties that bank and never expire.
greeting: The Lastlight Bounty Board. The notes glow faintly. Nobody pinned them. They were just there.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.
bark_after_act: Someone pinned a thank-you note to the board. It's addressed to you.

name: Pell
title: Retired Keeper
quirk: Once the Grey Guest. Trims the lighthouse wick once a week, because it's nice.
greeting: Oh, hello. Sit down, if you like. I've learned that sitting down is allowed.
barks: I trim the wick on Sundays. Only Sundays.
Thank you for asking me in. Everyone did, in the end.
Ada makes me rest. I make Ada rest. It's a system.
The Hush isn't bad. It's just night that forgot about morning.
Rest when you need to. I wish I had.
Tolly rings his bell when I visit. I like that very much.
Aldric saved me a seat. I sit in it every week.
bark_after_act: (Only appears after Act V.)

name: Bedtime for Bones
text_offer: The Rattlers climbed out of their graves and forgot why. Rekindle 10 and send them home to bed.
text_done: Ten sleepy Rattlers, back in bed. They even said goodnight!

name: Glitter Ingredients
text_offer: I need 8 Bone Meal for my potions. Don't ask. Ah— ACHOO! See? Very important. Well, a bit important. Whenever!
text_done: Perfect! One potion coming up. Stand back. Glitter incoming.

name: Where the Graves Went
text_offer: The old graveyard slid into the bog! Go and find the far end? I'd come too but *flicker*.
text_done: You found it! And came back! I knew you would. *no flicker*

name: Pocket Thief
text_offer: A Magpie Imp nicked something from pocket nineteen! It's in the Bellcrypt Halls. Catch it!
text_done: My thimble! And some extra gold? Keep that. The imp won't miss it. Much.

name: Too Many Candles
text_offer: Candle Mages keep lighting cold, grey candles. Wrong sort of light. Rekindle 5 of them?
text_done: Proper warm light again. I carved you a rune. It says 'ta'.

name: The Borrowed Yarn
text_offer: Madame Glimmerwick borrowed my silver yarn for a ring. Could you ask for it back? Nicely.
text_done: My silver yarn! The scarf grows another inch. Thank you, little light.

name: The Warden Below
text_offer: A Crypt Warden guards the Sunken Nave. It thinks it's still on duty. Relieve it of its shift.
text_done: The old Warden's resting at last. So can you, if you like.

name: The Bell Under the Water
text_offer: Every DONG makes someone fall asleep in the bog. Climb the Belfry of the Drowned and stop that bell.
text_done: It was Tolly. All this time, calling us home. And now he's home too.

name: Newt Test Drive
text_offer: Puddle wants to stretch her legs! Ride through the Bellcrypt Halls and back. She says please.
text_done: Puddle says that was the best day of her life. She says that every day.

name: Poke Every Stick
text_offer: Twiglings pretend to be sticks, then jump out. Rekindle 12 before I jump out of my boots.
text_done: Twelve sticks, twelve thank-yous. Only jumped nine times!

name: A Little Evening
text_offer: I need 3 Dusk Essence for a new elixir. Bottled evening. Smells like cocoa. *puff*
text_done: Marvellous! This elixir will be ever so glowy. *happy puff*

name: The Tower Question
text_offer: What's at the top of the Owl Towers? Why don't you go and see? And who'll tell me after?
text_done: You went. You saw. And now — what will you ask next?

name: Hoo's Grumpy
text_offer: The Snuffed Owlcrows scare my owlets. Rekindle 8? They'll be nicer after. Promise. Hoo.
text_done: The owlets are napping again. Hoo. Thank you. Hoo.

name: Dig Dog Trouble
text_offer: Moss Hounds keep digging up my buried stashes! Six of them! Help!
text_done: Stashes safe! I buried a snack for you. Somewhere!

name: A Riddle for Hob
text_offer: Riddle: what's green, grows on a face, and owes me money? Go ask Hob. Hoo-hoo!
text_done: He paid in acorns! Carved acorns! What a fine deal.

name: Hush, Birches
text_offer: The Gossiping Birches keep telling rumours about my axe. Walk through and shine your light?
text_done: Quiet at last. They only said one mean thing. Sorry, trees.

name: The Shadow Pantry
text_offer: Nobody in Whisperwood has a shadow. They're all in jars at Mother Bark's Pantry. Go gently.
text_done: My shadow came home! It's shy. It's hiding behind me. Thank you.

name: The Forgetful Crew
text_offer: My crew became Diglings. Rekindle 15 and maybe they'll remember why we dig.
text_done: They're back! They still don't know why. But they know they're friends.

name: SPIDERS!
text_offer: CRYSTAL SPIDERS IN THE GALLERY! My nephew won't go near them. Rekindle 8? THANK YOU!
text_done: No more clinking in the dark! My nephew says thank you from under the bed.

name: Wick Required
text_offer: I need 5 Wickthread for a fuse. A safe fuse! A mostly safe fuse!
text_done: It fizzled perfectly. Eyebrows intact. A good day!

name: That's Not Cart Six
text_offer: Cart six came back with TEETH. That's not cart six! Find the real one on the Rattletrack Rails?
text_done: The real cart six! And the toothy one ran home. Everyone's happy.

name: The First Line
text_offer: Barnaby used to hum the old song. Ask him if he remembers a line. Line.
text_done: 'Dig deep.' Two words. Two whole words! Words.

name: Floor Unknown
text_offer: The Saltwhistle Shafts aren't on my lift list. Go explore and I'll add a floor!
text_done: New floor! Floor Saltwhistle! Ding! Everybody out!

name: Lost Lamps
text_offer: Lamp ghosts are looking for their miners. Rekindle 6 so they can find their way home?
text_done: Dimple saw them float up the shaft, all glowy. She did a happy wiggle.

name: The Mountain's Voice
text_offer: The Mouth of the Mountain copies everything, backwards. Go and give it something good to repeat.
text_done: It's singing. The whole mountain. 'Dig deep, dig bright.' I remember now.

name: The Guest List
text_offer: Six place cards blew off the banquet table. Find them? Everyone deserves to know where to sit. It's item one.
text_done: All six! Everyone has a seat again. Even the ones who haven't thawed yet.

name: Who Moved?
text_offer: The porcelain dolls only move when you don't look. Rekindle 10! That's a royal order. Please.
text_done: Nobody moved! Except the right things! Sir Wobble says thank you.

name: Tea Served Wrongly
text_offer: My old colleagues, the Mirror Butlers, serve trap tea now. Rekindle 6. Kindly.
text_done: Six butlers restored. One offered me proper tea. I wept. Discreetly.

name: Stoking the Pot
text_offer: The big pot needs stoking. 20 Soot Dust keeps it bubbling for the thawing guests!
text_done: Bubbling beautifully! Have the first bowl, pet.

name: Hare Run
text_offer: Flurry wants to see the Frosted Gardens. Ride through? Wrap up warm first!
text_done: Flurry did twelve happy hops. Did you wrap up warm? Good.

name: A Joke for the Corporal
text_offer: The Corporal hasn't laughed since the freeze. Tell him my best joke: 'Why did the soldier salute the fridge?'
text_done: He laughed! Then saluted the laugh. That counts.

name: My Old Regiment
text_offer: My regiment froze on parade. Rekindle 12 tin soldiers and they'll march again! *salute*
text_done: They marched straight into the kitchen for soup. Good lads. *salute*

name: Who Are You?
text_offer: His Majesty sits in the Throne of Frost, forgetting. Remind him who he is.
text_done: '— and to all of you, who stayed.' He finished the toast. Item one: done.

name: Soft Shapes
text_offer: Hushlings drift over the Upside-Down Stars. Rekindle 15. Give them a bit of sound back.
text_done: Fifteen little hums. You can almost hear the Well breathing.

name: Grey Wings
text_offer: *sing* Some moths forgot their colours… Rekindle 10, little light, and bring them home!
text_done: *loud tiny cheer* Ten new voices in the Choir!

name: The Shiniest Leftovers
text_offer: The Drift of Leftovers has bits of everywhere floating about. Go look! Not to borrow. Just look.
text_done: You didn't borrow anything? Not even a tiny thing? …Respect.

name: Feed the Cauldron
text_offer: The Cauldron's peckish. 6 Dusk Essence, dearie? *burble*
text_done: *burble burble* That's a very happy burble.

name: The Quiet Stair
text_offer: …  (Nobody points down the Quiet Stair. Then at you. Then tips its hat.)
text_done: …!  (Nobody does a tiny, silent dance.)

name: Make Her Sit
text_offer: Ada hasn't sat down in forty years. Go and ask her to sit. Just for a minute.
text_done: She sat! For a whole minute! Then stood up. It's a start, love.

name: Old Guild Guards
text_offer: Faded Knights were Guild guards once. Rekindle 6 and I'll make them new lanterns.
text_done: Six new lanterns, six old friends back. Still learning, me.

name: The Lantern Room
text_offer: He's up there. Down there. In the Lantern Room. Don't fight to win, Wickbearer. Share your light.
text_done: He's home. The Lantern's lit. And for once, nobody's carrying it alone.

name: Bounty: Rattle Patrol
text_offer: BOUNTY: Rattlers wandering near the stilts again. Rekindle 25. No rush — this note will wait.
text_done: Bounty done! The village sleeps easier. The Rattlers do too.

name: Bounty: Arrows in the Reeds
text_offer: BOUNTY: Bog Archers keep shooting at the lamps. Rekindle 15.
text_done: Bounty done! The lamps thank you. Well, they flicker gratefully.

name: Bounty: Big Soup Order
text_offer: BOUNTY: Mother Mabble needs 15 Bone Meal for… soup? Don't ask.
text_done: Bounty done! Soup achieved. Nobody asked.

name: Borrowed Shields
text_offer: Those Shieldbones are carrying MY old shields. Rekindle 8 and Hammer Gerald gets his work back.
text_done: My shields! Dented, soggy, perfect. Gerald is thrilled.

name: Tidy the Graves
text_offer: Bonepiles clutter up the graves. Rekindle 5, dear. Tidy graves, tidy mind.
text_done: Lovely and tidy. Have a biscuit. It's a soup biscuit.

name: Something Warm in the Nave
text_offer: I heard there's a warm egg in the Sunken Nave. Go and look. Carefully. Eggs are delicate.
text_done: It's a mystery egg! Carry it around. It'll hatch when it's ready. Very professional.

name: Rings for Madame
text_offer: Darling, I need 2 Wick Topaz for a new ring. I'll wear it immediately. Then lose it.
text_done: Gorgeous! Now, where did I put the ring I was wearing…

name: Counting Spoons
text_offer: Mother… Mabble… borrowed… my… spoons. Ask… how… many.
text_done: Twelve… spoons. Twelve. I… counted… twice. Thank… you.

name: Runes for Supper
text_offer: I've run out of soot for my rune-ink. 10 Soot Dust, and I'll carve 'soup' on your spoon too.
text_done: Here's your spoon. It says 'soup'. Very useful.

name: The Top of the Tower
text_offer: Glim wants to see the top of the Belfry. From far away. Could you peek first? *flicker*
text_done: The view's lovely? Great! We'll go. Someday. *flicker*

name: Bounty: Stick Check
text_offer: BOUNTY: Twiglings pretending to be firewood. Rekindle 30. Take your time.
text_done: Bounty done! The firewood pile is just firewood now.

name: Bounty: Spore Season
text_offer: BOUNTY: Sporecaps puffing in the Hollow. Rekindle 15. Bring a hanky.
text_done: Bounty done! Spore levels: acceptable. *puff*

name: Bounty: Evening in a Bottle
text_offer: BOUNTY: The Professor wants 4 Dusk Essence. He says it's for science. It's for cocoa.
text_done: Bounty done! Science (cocoa) is served.

name: Sorry, Thorns
text_offer: Thorn Sprites are pricking my customers. Rekindle 10. And tell them sorry from me.
text_done: Thank you. I apologised to the brambles too, just in case.

name: The Grumpy Stump
text_offer: A huge Stump Grumble sits on the path to the Hollow. Grumbling. Rekindle it? Politely?
text_done: It stopped grumbling and started snoring. Much better. Have a hammock.

name: Gems That Stay
text_offer: I want gems that DON'T evaporate. 2 Moss Emeralds, please!
text_done: They're still here! It's been a whole minute! Thank you!

name: Thread for Runes
text_offer: I tie my rune-acorns with Wickthread. 3 lengths, if you've got them. Beard's holding the rest.
text_done: Lovely. My beard says thank you. It's grown a berry.

name: Fern Wants Out
text_offer: *whistles* That means: Fern wants a ride through Puffcap Hollow. You in?
text_done: *two happy whistles* Fern's never been sparklier.

name: Where Did I Bury It
text_offer: I buried something important in the Birches! Or near them! Or I dreamed it! Go look?
text_done: You found it! It's… an acorn. My favourite acorn! Thank you!

name: A Question for Quibble
text_offer: Will you ask Mister Quibble a question for me? Which question? Isn't that the question?
text_done: He answered with a riddle? And you answered with a question? Now who's the owl?

name: Bounty: Shift Change
text_offer: BOUNTY: Diglings digging where they shouldn't. Rekindle 30. Hard hats optional.
text_done: Bounty done! The tunnels are tidy. The Diglings went for a nap.

name: Bounty: Squeak Squad
text_offer: BOUNTY: Echo Bats copying everyone's sneezes. Rekindle 20.
text_done: Bounty done! Sneezes are private again.

name: Bounty: Fuse Supplies
text_offer: BOUNTY: Fizzwick needs 5 Wickthread. Again. For safety. Allegedly.
text_done: Bounty done! Only a small pop. Eyebrows mostly fine.

name: Too Much Salt
text_offer: Salt Golems are blocking the lower shaft. Rekindle 3. They're big, but they're softies.
text_done: Shaft's clear. One of the golems waved goodbye. With a whole arm of salt.

name: Dimple's Tunnel
text_offer: Dimple dug a tunnel to the Rattletrack Rails! Check it's safe? I'd go, but— actually I'd go. You go.
text_done: Safe! Dimple found a coin and a sock. She's keeping the sock.

name: Rubies for Polishing
text_offer: Bring me 2 Candle Rubies. I'm going to polish them until they blush.
text_done: *polish polish* Look at them glow. And look at you! *polish*

name: Chisel. Friend.
text_offer: Tuppence. Friend? Ask. Please.
text_done: Friend. Yes. Happy. Me.

name: Not For Sale
text_offer: Three toothy carts are pretending to be MY carts. Rekindle them before somebody buys one!
text_done: My real carts! Both of them! Two carts, zero teeth.

name: Shortcut Test
text_offer: I found a new shortcut through the Glittering Gallery. Test it on Gravel?
text_done: Four seconds faster! Gravel's thrilled. Other Gravel is jealous.

name: Mind the Laugh
text_offer: Tell Lou my laugh won't shake the lift any more. HA HA! …Tell him to hold on, actually.
text_done: Lou says 'Going up, going down, going wobbly.' HA HA! Fair.

name: Bounty: Tidy the Nursery
text_offer: BOUNTY: Porcelain dolls sneaking around the halls. Rekindle 25. Look behind you.
text_done: Bounty done! The dolls are back on their shelves. Probably.

name: Bounty: Cold Jokes
text_offer: BOUNTY: Frost Jesters telling freezing jokes. Rekindle 15. Don't laugh. Actually, laugh.
text_done: Bounty done! The jokes are warm again. Still not very good.

name: Bounty: Stoke the Kettle
text_offer: BOUNTY: The great kettle needs 25 Soot Dust. Nan Kettleby says thank you in advance.
text_done: Bounty done! Kettle's roaring. Tea for everyone.

name: Frozen Manners
text_offer: Ice Courtiers keep bowing people into snowdrifts. Rekindle 8. It's on my list. Item four.
text_done: Item four: done. Item five: have a sit-down. Please do item five.

name: Sled to the Hall
text_offer: Mister Fluffington wants to pull a sled to the Everlasting Toast. Wrap up warm! Then go!
text_done: Twelve seconds! A castle record! Did you wrap up? Good.

name: The Crown's Missing Sapphires
text_offer: Three sapphires fell off the crown when it froze. One is ashamed. Bring me 3 Frost Sapphires? *giggle*
text_done: The crown is complete! One is so pleased. *giggle giggle*

name: Please, No Kettle
text_offer: Ask Nan Kettleby to move the kettle ONE step to the left. Away from my ice.
text_done: She moved it one step. To the right. I'm choosing to be at peace.

name: Crumbs for Crumbsworth
text_offer: I need 10 Bone Meal. For baking. Mouse baking. It's a whole thing.
text_done: Squeak! Bone-meal biscuits! Try one. …Don't try one.

name: A Letter for Dad
text_offer: Give my letter to Mister Ledger. He'll keep it safe until Dad can read it.
text_done: Mister Ledger says it's filed under 'P' for 'Pip'. And 'P' for 'precious'.

name: Hound Drill
text_offer: Snow Hounds keep chewing my boots. Rekindle 12! *salute*
text_done: Boots saved! *salute* That was for you. *salute* That was for the boots.

name: Bounty: Soft Sweep
text_offer: BOUNTY: Hushlings drifting too close to the Landing. Rekindle 30. Go gently.
text_done: Bounty done! The Landing hums a little louder.

name: Bounty: Colour Back
text_offer: BOUNTY: Grey Moths without their colours. Rekindle 20. The Choir will sing about you.
text_done: Bounty done! The Choir sang. It was very small and very loud.

name: Bounty: Cauldron Supper
text_offer: BOUNTY: The Cauldron's peckish. 8 Dusk Essence. *burble* (that's from the Cauldron).
text_done: Bounty done! *burble burble*

name: The Silent Singers
text_offer: *sing* Four hollow choirs sing without sound… rekindle them, little light, bring their voices round!
text_done: *sing* Four new voices! Our harmony is complete! Nearly!

name: The Warmest Shiny
text_offer: Ember Hearts! The warmest shinies! Bring 2? I'll pay! Legally!
text_done: So warm! So shiny! I didn't even try to borrow them!

name: Where I Fell
text_offer: Find the spot where I fell, on the Upside-Down Stars? I want to know it's still there.
text_done: It's there? With a little dent? My dent! Aw.

name: Someone Who Doesn't Blink
text_offer: Keeper Stillwater never hurries. Maybe he never blinks. Ask him to read a rune for me?
text_done: He read it. Slowly. Without blinking. The rune is still glowing. I'm moved.

name: Dusty's Flight
text_offer: Take Dusty over the Drift of Leftovers! Goggles on! Goggles on indoors, too!
text_done: Dusty did a loop! Deliberately! Probably!

name: Jars for Fireflies
text_offer: I need 4 Wickthread to tie new firefly jars. The fireflies are very excited.
text_done: New jars! They'll come and go as they like. That's the whole point.

name: Tell Mae to Sit
text_offer: Mae's been at her anvil since breakfast. Yesterday's breakfast. Tell her to sit.
text_done: She sat! She's 'still learning' how. It's a start.
